subject.title: fix(slack): use endsWith instead of includes for _all_ action_id matching

question: Which permanent owner-controlled contract should identify OpenClaw Slack bulk-action rows without interpreting arbitrary external action IDs?
rationale: Current production code does not establish the proposed `_all` namespace, so selecting explicit block metadata, closed namespaced IDs, or a global suffix defines a compatibility contract for generic and plugin-supplied Slack blocks.

options.title: Explicit block marker
options.body: Mark bulk rows when produced and consume that OpenClaw-namespaced marker during confirmation updates.

options.title: Closed namespaced action IDs
options.body: Define a finite set of OpenClaw-owned bulk action IDs and share it between producer and consumer.

options.title: Reserve `_all` globally
options.body: Document and accept that every external action ID ending in `_all` may be treated as removable bulk UI.

recommendation.title: Explicit block marker
recommendation.body: Mark bulk rows when produced and consume that OpenClaw-namespaced marker during confirmation updates.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the block-action module split and have the strongest feature-history connection to this decision surface.
